pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: The riders behind Threshold, and why we build endurance kit tested on the long road rather than the showroom floor.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Threshold started with a simple complaint: too much cycling kit is designed for the photo and not the ride. It looks fast in the shop and falls apart at the point where a ride actually gets hard — the seam that chafes at hour four, the shell that wets out in the first real downpour, the chamois that gives up before you do.

So we build the other way round. Every piece is ridden long and hard before it ships — over passes, through winters, deep into the kind of distance where cheap kit shows its true colors. If it does not hold up out there, it does not get made. That is the whole standard, and it is not negotiable.
We are a small team of riders making kit for other riders. No sponsored pros, no seasonal churn for its own sake — just gear built to earn its place in your kit bag and stay there for years.
